hypothesis: Retaining all 200 LSTM cells and full external/feed-forward inputs while feeding back only 64 self-recurrent cells preserves output capacity better than width reduction and removes a large fraction of recurrent gate dot products.
kill_condition: The smallest stable scope exhausts the 110677-byte score margin, runtime improves less than 8 percent, or disjoint transfer regresses materially.
promotion_condition: Changed-stream 250K projects at or below 108000000 and reduces alternating guarded runtime by at least 10 percent; then exact 1M and 10M transfer, roundtrip, determinism, memory, and package accounting pass.
title: Wide-output endpoint428 with bounded recurrent fan-in
